name: Restore CLAUDE.md context for subagents
description: Re-enables CLAUDE.md (project/user memory) context for built-in read-only subagents (Explore/Plan) and disables the slim-subagent trim regression introduced in v2.1.84+. Flips the minified omitClaudeMd flag from true (!0) to false (!1) on the built-in agent definitions and flips the tengu_slim_subagent_claudemd feature-gate default from true to false in runAgent's shouldOmitClaudeMd computation, so subagents again receive the full CLAUDE.md user context.

provenance.author: anthropics/claude-code issue #40459 reporter
provenance.derived_by: Reverse-engineered from inline sed patches in GitHub issue #40459 (s/omitClaudeMd:!0/omitClaudeMd:!1/g and s/"tengu_slim_subagent_claudemd",!0/"tengu_slim_subagent_claudemd",!1/g), mapped to 2.1.88 source (exploreAgent.ts, runAgent.ts) and verified against pristine 2.1.158 binary.

operations.rationale: Built-in Explore (external/haiku) agent definition sets omitClaudeMd:true. The bare 'omitClaudeMd:!0' occurs twice, so the anchor includes the preceding model:"haiku" literal to be unique. Flipping !0->!1 sets omitClaudeMd:false so this subagent keeps CLAUDE.md.
Second built-in agent definition (inherit model) sets omitClaudeMd:true. Anchor widened with preceding model:"inherit" literal for uniqueness. Flipping !0->!1 restores CLAUDE.md for this subagent.

runAgent computes shouldOmitClaudeMd = agentDefinition.omitClaudeMd && !override.userContext && getFeatureValue('tengu_slim_subagent_claudemd', true). The literal default true (!0) is the in-region runtime gate. Anchor includes the trailing ',!0' (uniquely the plaintext getFeatureValue call; a second bare 'tengu_slim_subagent_claudemd' in a bytecode metadata blob outside the CJS region is not matched). Flipping the default to false disables the slim trim even when the GrowthBook flag is unavailable.
